interpretation.post_outcome_audit: Signal-based candidates substantially shift the training-label distribution toward unstable structures; this is descriptive evidence for a missing distribution-matching constraint, not a prospective explanation test.
interpretation.primary_panel: Coverage leads at 256 and 512 structures; hash-uniform leads at 1024.
interpretation.prospective_result: The frozen signal-plus-coverage point prediction missed the best candidate at all three budgets.
interpretation.secondary_panel: No candidate mean exceeds the starting checkpoint's macro Top-100 stable rate on MP20.
